Chapter 624: Warning The bathroom had a partition. The emanating steam covered the entire bathtub. Apart from his head, Klein's entire body was soaked in the hot water. He lay there in such great comfort that he didn't even wish to move his toes. What a beautiful night... If only there was no Cynthia outside. I still have to deal with her later... Klein sighed as he considered what excuse to use to avoid being intimate with her. In keeping with Admiral Amyrius Rieveldt's character, he decided to use work as his first excuse. After that, he could claim to feel unwell, to have lost the ability to have sex, to need time to absorb some medicine he had just taken, or to have suddenly discovered his true sexual orientation and developed an intense attraction to curly-haired baboons. As for whether this would damage the admiral's image, Klein didn't feel the slightest bit of pressure. As long as he prevented Cynthia from suspecting that he was a fake Amyrius Rieveldt, he would've perfectly completed his mission. Explaining those excuses afterward, along with his eventual recovery, would be Admiral Amyrius's problem. What does that have to do with me, Gehrman Sparrow? And what does Gehrman Sparrow's ruined reputation have to do with me, Sherlock Moriarty? Satisfied, Klein stood and stepped dripping wet into the dry partition. He took a bath towel and dried himself. After putting on a bathrobe hanging nearby, Klein silently drew a breath as though he were about to face a formidable enemy, then opened the bathroom door. Seeing the corridor empty, with only the light from the wall lamps on both sides illuminating the darkness, Klein felt slightly relieved and was no longer as tense. This feels almost the same as challenging a pirate admiral... As he muttered to himself, he realized there was a serious problem. He had no idea which rooms were the master bedroom and the study. Regardless, I have to inform Cynthia; otherwise, it would make Admiral Amyrius appear strange... Klein recalled the layout of similar houses in an attempt to accurately find the master bedroom. At this moment, the door to the room diagonally across him creaked open. Cynthia, who was draped in a silk nightgown, walked over. Her blonde hair cascaded down in damp disarray, a few strands hanging before her blue eyes and bright-red lips. They partially concealed the light in her eyes, while her lips were slightly parted. She appeared extremely alluring in the dim light. The silk nightgown had a plunging neckline, revealing snow-white skin and deep cleavage to Klein's gaze. Klein nearly raised his head to look at the ceiling to avoid the intense stimulation. Calm down, calm down. You are Amyrius Rieveldt... Besides, you've seen a half-naked Demoness before... Compared to an Ailment Maiden, this lady's charms are clearly insufficient. Wait, why am I thinking about Demonesses? Who knows if they were formerly men or women... Klein maintained his gaze as he sized her up and down with a "teasing" tone. In that instant, he could sense that primal desire, but there was no response from his nether regions... This is the result of the temporary contract? In fact, Admiral Amyrius didn't need to go through the trouble. Even if I have the urge, I'll be able to control myself... What kind of situation haven't I encountered before? Yes... Cynthia is a little different from what the records describe. Didn't she become Amyrius's mistress one or two years ago? Since they spend most of their time apart, doesn't the admiral usually have to coax her because her pent-up desires haven't been satisfied? Why is she the one taking the initiative today? Does she find her standing as his mistress unstable, or has she been switched? Ever since Klein became a Faceless, he felt that everyone was a fake. Cynthia lowered her eyelids. The courage she had mustered ebbed away beneath Amyrius's scrutiny. A deep blush spread across her face; she was embarrassed but also somewhat proud. Then, she heard him calmly instruct, "Help me prepare some coffee and place it in my study. "I have many things to deal with tonight. You don't have to wait for me." Cynthia raised her head suddenly, her embarrassed blushing still present. She had momentarily failed to understand what Admiral Amyrius had said. Klein secretly inhaled and went forward to hug her before kissing her gently on the forehead. "I'll spend plenty of time with you in a few days." Such a response came from the provided information, but he had slightly changed the terms. To be frank, without some prior understanding, Klein would have believed that Admiral Amyrius wore the same stoic expression while spending time with his mistress, even during sex. He looked stern in everything he said and did, but this demigod also had a gentle side to his speech. He simply wasn't very good at sweet nothings. This also made him understand something else: a person's outward appearance rarely revealed what they were like in private. For a Faceless to achieve a convincing disguise, they had to investigate meticulously and thoroughly understand the target. Just as a Magician never performed unprepared, neither could a Faceless. Cynthia revealed a clear look of disappointment, but she quickly restrained those feelings as she smiled. "Alright. "Admiral, your nightgown is in the room. A bathrobe isn't suitable for handling matters." This matches the information exactly. She's quite considerate and understanding... Klein watched Cynthia turn and enter the room before pulling the bell cord. He took the opportunity to remove his bathrobe and change into a dark-red nightshirt with trousers of the same color. Cynthia thoughtfully opened the study door and tidied the slightly cluttered desk. Then she waited for the maidservant to finish making the coffee before personally carrying it in. Meanwhile, Klein read the documents and reports with an air of consummate professionalism. In fact, he understood almost nothing about the specifications and designs of ironclad warships and sailing battleships. In this field, he was practically illiterate. All he knew in this field were aircraft carriers, air superiority, main guns, and turrets. When he saw Cynthia silently leave and close the door behind her from the corner of his eye, Klein relaxed completely. He knew that he had finally survived the night. Inside the master bedroom, Cynthia pursed her lips as she took the necklace from beneath her pillow and tightly clasped the finger-segment-long pendant resembling a black rhinoceros horn. She stood there and silently prayed, Oh, great Mother Tree of Desire, please make me more alluring. Let Admiral Amyrius become even more captivated by me, so that he can derive the greatest pleasure from me and give me a child... Inside the quiet study, Klein flipped through the pile of documents before him. Following the procedures described in the information, he selected the simple ones and signed Amyrius Rieveldt's name on them. He could imitate the admiral's signature because Faceless allowed him to remember a target's distinctive traits, while Clown gave him the precise control required. The complicated ones he couldn't understand had notes written with the following message: "Continue studying the matter." After "busying" himself until midnight, Klein reached out to cover his mouth and yawned slightly. This won't do. I need to sleep. I have plenty of challenges tomorrow. I have to maintain sufficient strength and energy... Klein thought for a moment and gave up the idea of returning to the master bedroom. He raised his right hand and pressed down on his half-closed eyes. He pulled them down and moved his eyes to his nose bridge. Following that, Klein opened two slits where his eyes had originally been and shaped his flesh into a pair of fake eyes. After becoming a Faceless, I'm really beginning to resemble a monster... If only I had such a godly technique back in school... He sighed silently. He half leaned his body as he kept his real eyes closed while his fake eyes were left open to "read" the documents. His specialty as a Clown allowed him to maintain his balance. He remained motionless like a stone statue. After an unknown period of time, Klein suddenly awoke from his dream. He sensed that there was a force attempting to pull him into a deep slumber before infiltrating him! Who is it? I haven't done anything recently. Why would anyone enter my dream? That's not right. I'm Admiral Amyrius Rieveldt now... Klein's heart stirred as he immediately changed his appearance. Even in his dream, he assumed the form of that demigod. Meanwhile, he felt his consciousness tightly contract as though it was avoiding something. This is different from an ordinary dream infiltration. I've clearly regained lucidity, and I should be able to escape and wake up on my own, yet I can't leave this dreamscape... Klein noticed numerous peculiarities as he made several attempts. He knew very well that he was sleeping, and he could sense and control his body outside the dream, but no matter what he did, he was unable to wake up! Right on the heels of that, he saw a blurry white gas form an indiscernible figure. Klein narrowed his eyes slightly as he tore through the dream with his psyche, allowing his real body to move silently. Then, he put his palm into his pocket to touch the Ninth Law charm. At that moment, the blurry figure calmly said, "Do not participate in the matter regarding Aston. "This is a warning." ... Quite impressive, daring to warn a demigod... What are Aston and the others planning? Klein thought for a moment and released his spirituality, prompting the Ninth Law charm to emanate an overwhelming air of authority. He then reproduced that aura in his dream and asked in a deep voice, "Who are you? "Who do you represent?" The blurry figure was taken aback before he said with a laughing sigh, "As expected of Law Weaver Amyrius. You actually managed to maintain your lucidity in such a situation." No, no, no. Although Amyrius bears the title of Law Weaver, he isn't skilled in such matters. You should say, 'As expected of Lord Fool'... Klein lampooned inwardly and said sternly, "Answer my question." The blurry figure chuckled. "You don't need to know who I am. "As a demigod, you should be clear that everything is fated, likewise for the times. "Do not resist the fate of an era, which is also the trend of the times. This will only make you a sacrifice of history." Fate of an era, the trend of the times, sacrifice of history... When he heard this, Klein suddenly thought of a term: Twilight Hermit Order! However, Klein said nothing, much less uttered that name, because he would be Admiral Amyrius for the next few days. Seeing Law Weaver Amyrius fall silent, the blurry figure said nothing more. It dissolved into wisps of white mist before vanishing from the dream.
Chapter 625: Successful First Day Phew. What exactly are Amyrius and Aston Rieveldt plotting to have drawn a warning from the Twilight Hermit Order...? Unless something can truly alter the era and influence the course of history, this ancient and secretive organization won't even show itself or reveal its existence... In his dream, Klein stood beside a magnificent castle, thoughtfully watching the spot where the blurry figure had disappeared. Amidst his thoughts, he suddenly snapped awake and was no longer as certain about his theory. The scheme Admiral Amyrius and his brother are planning might not truly affect the trend of the times! Although the Twilight Hermit Order involved itself only in important matters, Klein, as the leader of another secret organization, knew perfectly well that its members would help one another in addition to pursuing the organization's mission and ideals. From Emperor Roselle's diary, I can tell that the Twilight Hermit Order has members from different fields, social standings, and Sequences. Some fervently believe in the original Creator, awaiting the coming of twilight and the awakening of the true god, but the rest seek only their own benefit. Under such circumstances, unless the organizer strictly enforces discipline, the members will naturally entrust one another with personal missions. Perhaps, the matter Aston Rieveldt is planning affects a particular member of the Twilight Hermit Order who was made aware of it ahead of time. He entrusted the matter to another member and used the excuse of "the trend of the times" to warn Amyrius Rieveldt... Following this logic, the hidden matter becomes rather interesting... For an organization at the Twilight Hermit Order's level, eliminating Law Weaver Amyrius, who is likely only Sequence 4, wouldn't be too difficult. I even suspect they can mobilize three or more angels, far surpassing the seven Churches in this respect... Then why didn't they act directly instead of issuing a warning in advance? Back in Backlund, if an angel were to appear, who knew whether a true god might descend. Therefore, the Twilight Hermit Order had no choice but to use a more circuitous and discreet method to deal with Duke Negan. But this is Oravi Island. There aren't even any High-Sequence Beyonders stationed here... Did they issue the warning because the Twilight Hermit Order values secrecy and wishes to avoid exposing itself through drastic methods, or because the member who commissioned the mission doesn't want Amyrius killed? Is this admiral still useful to "him," making him unwilling to abandon Amyrius even if he might be involved in something detrimental to him? Then, his true identity seems to be confined to certain circles... Klein made a bold assumption, but with no way of verifying it, he could only temporarily put the matter aside and relegate it to the back of his mind. It has nothing to do with me, since the Twilight Hermit Order is warning Admiral Amyrius... As long as I don't involve myself in anything over the next few days, I should make it through the mission. Whatever happens afterward has nothing to do with me! At my present level, I'm still far from being able to investigate the Twilight Hermit Order. I don't even have the right to probe any deeper... Klein held fast to his principles and turned his attention to the Tarot Club. Heh, I've just noticed a problem. Other secret organizations are built around their own goals and ideals, with members helping one another on the side. Our Tarot Club is even more impressive. We only have members assigning one another missions, without any common goals or ideals... No, some members do believe we have them. For example, my dear Moon believes this organization was created to save the world... The Fool Klein gave a self-deprecating laugh before leaving the dreamscape. He smoothly erased the fake eyes and moved his real eyes back to their original position, only to pause abruptly. That wasn't a simple dream infiltration! Klein frowned slightly as he recalled what had happened. That was because the power had first attempted to pull him into a deep slumber! I was already asleep, so why would he do that? Captain once said that a Nightmare can directly view dreams, so one couldn't make such a mistake... Therefore, the visitor hadn't used a Nightmare's Beyonder powers, but something else... Did he locate me through the spirit world? Or, after learning my location, did he use the sea of collective subconscious described by Ma'am Daly to influence me directly with his Beyonder powers? Yes... I'm more inclined to the second reason. That's the only thing that can explain why I couldn't escape my dream despite having regained lucidity. It's recorded in Emperor Roselle's diary that during his participation in the suspected Twilight Hermit Order, his entry into the gathering was based on a realistic dreamscape that encompassed the entire continent. A realistic dreamscape... Klein nodded and chuckled silently with a sigh. Admiral Amyrius definitely didn't expect the Twilight Hermit Order's warning. It's only because he hired me. If it were anyone else, the stand-in would've already been exposed! That Ninth Law charm was well worth it. City of Silver, inside the spire, in the room belonging to Chief Colin Iliad. Derrick Berg, who had been summoned, saw the grizzled, scarred Demon Hunter once again as he felt uneasy. After he finished his greetings, Colin sized him up and asked, "You've advanced?" "Yes, I'm already a Sequence 7 Solar High Priest." Derrick had long reported his advancement, so there was no need to hide the matter. Colin's light-blue eyes which had seen the vicissitudes of time moved away as he casually asked, "Do you have the subsequent potion formulas?" The old Derrick would have answered "no" immediately, but he had since learned to think before replying. If I say "no," advancing again without the corresponding experience will definitely make me look suspicious. But if I answer "yes," the Chief might ask me to exchange it for items that could help nurture more Sun pathway Beyonders. That would undoubtedly expose my lie... Derrick's mind raced before he answered sincerely, "No." From his point of view, experience could be forged. Colin nodded as if nothing was out of the ordinary. "In about two months, we'll assign you another exploration mission. The team will secure the route and the ruins we found with Jack's help before conducting a second sweep. "I hope you will receive greater rewards then." "Yes, Your Excellency." Just as Derrick answered, he suddenly recalled Shepherd Lovia. After daybreak, Klein dressed with Cynthia's help, enjoyed a sumptuous breakfast, and rode to the Oravi naval base in a carriage escorted by the admiral's bodyguards. That morning, accompanied by rear admirals and colonels, he inspected the condition of the ships, the ordnance stores, the newly built training grounds, and the bathroom that had been renovated twenty times over the past year. After having lunch at the navy mess hall, Klein followed the schedule and summoned all officers above the rank of major to hear their reports. Throughout the proceedings, a thick, black-bound notebook lay before him. It contained questions Admiral Amyrius had specially prepared for him. "In the past few decades, due to embezzled wages and the harsh conditions endured by sailors, Oravi has seen seventeen revolts among the lower ranks. Since the passage of the Imperial Navy Latest Act, and thanks to Your Excellency's guidance, we've improved these deep-seated institutional problems. There haven't been any such incidents in the past three years..." A colonel from the Oravi naval base stood before him and delivered his report. From time to time, he raised his head to look at Admiral Amyrius Rieveldt and found him listening intently while taking notes. The sound of his scribbling kept every officer on their toes, and they likewise noted the important points. The colonel who received a positive response unknowingly spoke up louder while reporting. How boring... Klein held his fountain pen and had randomly drawn creatures like turtles, cuttlefish, and dragons on his black-bound notebook. As he had never studied sketching before, his drawings were a ghastly sight to see. Later, he even drew a grid and began playing Five-in-a-Row against himself, a game invented by Emperor Roselle. Of course, his rich experience and his conscientious approach to his identity made him raise his head from time to time to give the reporter a stern look in the eye while giving a nod of encouragement. As for what the person had said, he didn't pay any attention to it. All he did was occasionally remember a few words. During the briefing, Klein shot a glance at the blond secretary, Luan, to get him to speak for him and mention a few points that needed clarification. Everything followed the schedule. Toward the end, Klein flipped several pages forward in the black-bound notebook and, in the accent of a Loen aristocrat, recited the speech drafted by the secretary and revised by the admiral. Then, adapting it to the circumstances, he employed Amyrius's usual wording and added a few transitions and habitual phrases, such as "There are several points" and "Allow me to elaborate on a few more points." It was already evening by the time the briefing ended. Accompanied by Luan, Klein left the Oravi naval base and headed to a banquet at the residence of a naval supplier. At the banquet, they casually discussed fluctuations in the prices of goods at the port. Klein imitated Admiral Amyrius by occasionally telling an old Backlund joke, drawing warm responses and praise for his humor. After successfully acting until the banquet ended, Klein boarded the carriage, feeling exhausted in body and mind. I have to watch every word and action, every minute and every second. Staying truly in character for an entire day is more exhausting than fighting a pirate admiral... Klein sighed inwardly and half-closed his eyes without changing his expression. He knew that the most difficult stage of the day wasn't over! He still had to deal with Cynthia! Inside the villa, Cynthia learned from the attendant who had gone out to make inquiries that Admiral Amyrius was about to return. She quietly returned to her bedroom, took out the tiny black rhinoceros horn pendant, and used a metallic plate to scratch off tiny bits of powder, mixing it into the hot water inside a white porcelain teacup. After repeating the honorific name of the Mother Tree of Desire seven times, she waited nearly a minute before lifting the teacup in hope, cleanly downing it.
Chapter 626: Amyrius's Decision Looking at the light spilling from the villa into the darkness, Klein spent several seconds mentally preparing himself before alighting from the carriage. He climbed the three-tiered steps and entered through the door, where the admiral's bodyguards and servants stood in lines on either side. Seeing Cynthia dressed conservatively because others were present, Klein silently heaved a sigh of relief. Maintaining his stoic expression, he slowly walked over. Cynthia's smile became more and more brilliant as she shifted the strands of her hair to the back of her ear, revealing her fair and slender neck. Her neckline didn't have any marks left behind by a necklace. Seeing Secretary Luan and the admiral's bodyguards head to their rooms or move outside to take up their patrol positions, Klein pulled Cynthia into an embrace and said in a deep voice, "There's no need to prepare hot water. Give me a quiet room. I need to spend the night alone." "..." Cynthia used her eyes to express her puzzlement and blankness. Klein surveyed his surroundings and softly said, "Something unexpected happened. I need to enter an extremely quiet state to recover." As he spoke, he raised his right hand to pull at his collar, revealing a patch of pale fleshy granules. An abnormal physical condition was the excuse Admiral Amyrius had prepared for the tramp stand-in, allowing him to avoid Cynthia's attempts at intimacy without arousing suspicion. To make it more convincing, Klein used his Faceless powers to provide "evidence." Cynthia's mouth fell open as she nearly screamed. Thankfully, she covered her mouth in time and held it in. As soon as Cynthia recovered from her shock, she asked nervously, her concern evident, "Are you all right? Do you need to see a doctor?" "No, this is the price needed for powerful strength. I'll recover given two to three days of solitude." Klein had already found the excuse needed for the future. "O-okay." Cynthia hurriedly helped Klein up to the second floor and led him into the quietest room. As for the master bedroom, she had already lit some scented candles and scattered some faint-smelling extract, so she didn't offer it to him. Seeing the door close, Klein slowly exhaled. He changed out of his admiral's uniform and lay down in satisfaction. Not far away in the master bedroom, the worried and disappointed Cynthia soaked in hot water before sleeping. She looked at the ceiling with an unfocused gaze as she couldn't help but recall the exhortations of her parents from a few days ago. They wanted her to captivate Admiral Amyrius and, if possible, become pregnant with his child. This would allow their family to secure more business from the Central Sonia Sea fleet. The admiral seems to have so many worries buried in his heart that something abnormal has happened to his body... Cynthia's thoughts wandered and gradually faded. Without her realizing it, she had fallen asleep. During this time, she felt warmth spread through her digestive tract, and her body grew slightly hot. In her dream, she seemed to see a pitch-black sky dotted with resplendent stars. One of them seemed to notice her gaze as it produced a brighter glow. The next morning, the refreshed Klein enjoyed a sumptuous, uneventful breakfast. Once again surrounded by the admiral's bodyguards, he arrived at the Oravi naval base and settled into its most luxurious and spacious office. Admiral Amyrius habitually spent time alone every two or three days, deepening his understanding and mastery of his Beyonder powers and developing more effective techniques. Therefore, Klein spent most of the day undisturbed and only had to handle some simple work. Inside the quiet and spacious office, Klein leisurely paced about or flipped through books from the bookshelf. From time to time, he would put his palm into his pockets to touch the Ninth Law charm to release some of its powerful might. This was to make Secretary Luan, who was outside, believe that there was nothing wrong with Admiral Amyrius. After some time, Klein felt sleepy and decided to take a short nap.
