It didn't include the recognition of gluttony, pride, and desire. This was at odds with a number of victims earlier. The other honorific titles of the Evernight Goddess didn't include the corresponding domains. This does coincide with the traits of the Devil pathway. A Desire Apostle is an expert in such matters... Could the one subjugating the Primordial Moon be a high-level Devil, or even the King of Devils who's known as the Dark Side of the Universe, Sequence 0 Abyss? This is very possible, but the problem with this is that it shouldn't produce the illusory cosmos and bright stars. Be it Moon or Abyss, they have nothing to do with the corresponding symbols... Klein found his conjecture problematic the more he thought over the matter. Amidst his thoughts, he suddenly thought of a concept. It was something important back when he was first educated in mysticism but had never received a detailed description or explanation! That was the astral world! Apart from the Life School of Thought and a few other organizations that believed in uncommon concepts such as the world of absolute rationality, most schools of mysticism held that existence comprised the real world, the spirit world, and the astral world. The real world needed no explanation, and knowledge of the spirit world formed the foundation of many forms of ritualistic magic and numerous Beyonder powers. Only of the astral world did Klein know virtually nothing. Therefore, the illusory cosmos represents the astral world. The bright star is a particular existence in the astral world? I've always suspected that the astral world is where the true gods reside. Then, this imagery which represents the Primordial Moon isn't something unacceptable... Klein didn't think further as he recalled the details of the past few days while awaiting the results of his subordinates' investigations. Time ticked by when Klein finally heard a familiar gait approach. Secretary Luan knocked before entering. He bowed his head and coldly reported, "Your Excellency. We've already found the Naturism Sect and captured their leader. "It was a clue provided by Miss Cynthia's parents. "This sect has been rather active in Oravi over the past few years. Its members refuse to wear clothes in an attempt to return to nature. Their aim is to surrender to their instincts, and they believe humans can liberate their spirituality in such a state. "Reproduction of the next generation is a subsidiary product of this belief." After pausing for a moment, Luan added, "Their leader is a Beyonder, a Sequence 8 Lunatic." Lunatic? A Lunatic from the Prisoner pathway? It has something to do with the Rose School of Thought? Yes, the Rose School of Thought internally has two factions, "temperance" and "indulgence." The latter's beliefs are rather identical to the present situation... Klein was alarmed as he said in a stoic tone, "Bring him here."
Chapter 630: Timeline The leader of the Naturism Sect was named Flight Ken, a man in his thirties. His thin face had brown sideburns, and there were evil-looking tattoos on his neck. Luan brought him before Klein. He looked haggard, as though he had suffered the most severe mental torment. "Your Excellency, during his capture, he repeatedly exchanged his sanity for strength and is now on the verge of a mental collapse..." Luan reported the facts without considering that Admiral Amyrius might already be able to discern the details. That's perfect... Klein had been worried that, as a Lunatic, Flight Ken would refuse to answer questions even under mental pressure. In that case, he would have had to risk arousing suspicion by dismissing his subordinates and attempting spirit channeling. As he looked coldly at Flight Ken, Klein's left hand gleamed gold beneath the cover of the desk. He had switched Creeping Hunger to the Interrogator's soul! Interrogator happened to be Sequence 7 of Admiral Amyrius's Arbiter pathway! Two indistinct flashes of lightning appeared deep in Klein's eyes, superimposing themselves over Flight Ken's figure. Psychic Piercing was poised for attack! However, Klein didn't use the Beyonder power directly, as it was only at the Sequence 7 level. If he used it in front of Luan, the blond secretary would immediately see through his disguise. Pressing Psychic Piercing against Flight Ken's Spirit Body, Klein sat like the real Admiral Amyrius and asked in a deep voice, "Do you know Cynthia?" As he spoke, he raised his right hand and let the miniature black rhinoceros horn dangle from his palm. "What is its use?" The dispirited Flight Ken trembled. He felt as though a dagger hovered against his psyche, ready to pierce it at any moment. He couldn't help but lower his head as he stammered, "Yes, I know her. "Cynthia--Miss Cynthia wished to have a child with Your Excellency, a child with Beyonder powers. She was introduced to me by her parents. "It's a Proliferation Necklace created with an aura bestowed by the goddess. By consuming its powder and wearing it for a prolonged period, she... she would make herself irresistible to Your Excellency..." Klein listened in silence, only half convinced by Flight Ken's explanation. He still had his doubts. He believed this was indeed part of Cynthia's goal. Whether of her own volition or at the urging of others, this beautiful lady truly wished to have a child with Admiral Amyrius. Her persistence even after mutating made that clear. Although the Loen Kingdom's aristocrats disliked and even discriminated against their illegitimate children, circumstances mattered. A child who successfully inherited the father's Beyonder characteristics would still be highly valued. Ancient families privy to many secrets placed particular importance on this, and the Rieveldt family was one of them. Furthermore, Admiral Amyrius appears stern and old-fashioned, but he cherishes those close to him. Even an illegitimate child would receive his love and be treated as important... This might be the true reason Cynthia was so eager to bear his child... Klein sighed inwardly. His doubts about Flight Ken's answer centered on the Proliferation Necklace's true effects and the possibility that the Naturism Sect had deliberately misled Cynthia. As he intensified the pressure of Psychic Piercing, Klein silently stared into Flight Ken's eyes until the man could bear it no longer and lowered his head again. "What other uses does this necklace have?" Klein shook the cracked pendant. His tone was calm, as though he knew every secret. His questions were only to obtain the final confirmation. An indescribable pressure engulfed Flight Ken, who was already on the verge of mental collapse. He crumpled to the ground and shouted almost hysterically, "I-it can corrupt you! "As long as Cynthia consumed the powder ground from it and sincerely chanted Mother Tree of Desire's honorific name, a-any man who has sex with her and successfully has a child would be corrupted! "Th-that will turn you into a believer of the Mother Tree of Desire! Into one of 'Her' Blessed!" So that's how it is... Klein instantly understood the entire story, and he was no longer puzzled by the mutation that happened that very night. The Naturism Sect's goal is to use Cynthia and the ordinary-looking Proliferation Necklace to corrupt Admiral Amyrius, turning this important Loen military figure into a devout believer of the Mother Tree of Desire. He could then help their sect grow and provide it with protection. The key to this method's success is how thoroughly concealed and innocuous it appears. Nothing about it immediately suggests concepts such as "powerful," "lethal," or "terrifying." Therefore, after I rejected her three times, Cynthia was unable to discharge the corruptive power of the Proliferation Necklace's powder from her body. She gradually reached her limit, finally connected with the Mother Tree of Desire, and underwent what appeared to be a sudden mutation... Therefore, the mutated monster couldn't have posed a real threat to Admiral Amyrius. Even my use of the Ninth Law charm easily resolved the matter. That's because this wasn't the outcome the Naturism Sect wanted. They sought to corrupt Admiral Amyrius in secret, not clash with a demigod... Klein silently looked at Secretary Luan. Luan had also gained a rough understanding of the entire situation. He immediately lowered his head and said in a deep voice, "Your Excellency, it was our oversight. "We only monitored Miss Cynthia and the servants here without expanding the monitoring to their friends and family. "I'm willing to accept any punishment for this, even if you have me court-martialed." How would the real admiral reply? Klein once again immersed himself in the character of Amyrius, experiencing his recent pain, helplessness, grief, and anger. He maintained his seating posture and sternly said, "We shall leave this for later." The sentence carried an unspoken meaning: "I'll decide based on your performance from now on." Luan was taken aback for a second, seemingly finding the admiral's mild punishment unbelievable. Klein half-closed his eyes and said in a deep voice, "My father, the late Earl Rieveldt, once taught me this. "He said to pardon the first mistake of a subordinate. "Luan, you, as well as the other bodyguards, should be thankful for his benevolence." Luan's gaze flickered as he drew a silent breath. No longer quite so calm, he said earnestly, "Your benevolence is admirable. "I pledge you my utmost loyalty, second only to my principles, my god, and my kingdom." Your pride truly knows no bounds... Klein didn't believe him and said with apparent calm, "The saying has a second half: 'Punish them for their second mistake.'" Luan nodded, unsurprised. Klein turned his gaze back to Flight Ken, who was slumped on the ground. Without changing his expression, he pressed, "Who instigated you to do this?" In his view, Flight Ken would likely answer that they had devised the plan themselves. After coming into contact with Cynthia, learning of her desire, and discovering her lover's identity, the Naturism Sect had boldly conceived the idea of corrupting Admiral Amyrius. Flight glanced left and right nervously before saying with trepidation, "I-it was the Mother Tree of Desire. 'She' instructed me to do it in a dream. I-in the beginning, I only wanted to lend Cynthia the Proliferation Necklace for her to wear. I never planned for her to consume the powder." Instigated by the Mother Tree of Desire? This is almost equivalent to a revelation... Klein nearly frowned. Although Admiral Amyrius is an important figure in the Loen military and the highest commander of the Central Sonia Sea, giving him considerable status and power, he shouldn't be important enough to attract an evil goddess's personal attention... However, I'm not an evil god. I have no way to comprehend how they think. Perhaps corrupting Amyrius is part of some later plan... Yes, I also can't rule out the possibility that Flight Ken is lying. I'll have to confirm it later... Klein thought before asking sternly, "When did you have this dream?" Flight forced a fearful smile and said, "I-it was the night of 4th February, last Friday. I-I remember it very clearly. I had just released a lady's spirituality." 4th February... Klein ruminated over the date, momentarily unable to find anything special about it. After two seconds of silence, he turned to ask, "What relationship do you have with the Rose School of Thought? "What relationship does the Mother Tree of Desire have with the Chained God?" He wasn't concerned that Admiral Amyrius might already know the answer or that Secretary Luan might understand the matter to some extent. The question could easily be interpreted as a request for confirmation. Flight Ken revealed a fervor he could barely contain. "W-we're a branch of the Rose School of Thought. My mentor is the Rose School of Thought's saint, Zatwen. "The Chained God is another manifestation of the Mother Tree of Desire. "The Mother Tree of Desire is the one true deity, surpassing the seven gods and the True Creator! "Your Excellency, you are a candidate to be 'Her' Blessed!" Anyone can boast... Does this mean the Mother Tree of Desire is another identity of the Chained God? According to the evil spirit in the underground ruins suspected to be Red Angel Medici, the Prisoner and Devil pathways are interchangeable at the divine level. Therefore, it isn't surprising that the Rose School of Thought's Chained God can magnify the various desires of living beings. The School also has internal temperance and indulgence factions... This matches the situation... Klein thought as he turned to Luan and said, "Leave us for a while." He planned to question Flight Ken about whether he had committed any evil deeds and whether he was suitable as a meal for Creeping Hunger. "Yes, Your Excellency." Without asking why, Luan briskly walked out of the study and closed the door behind him. After the echo of the closing door faded, the entire study suddenly fell silent, as though isolated from the outside world. A Baron of Corruption's Beyonder power? Did he Distort the act of "closing the door" to seal the study? Very considerate... Klein pondered for a few seconds as he recalled his earlier train of thought. Then he suddenly asked, "6th February. What did you do on Sunday evening?" Flight Ken was taken aback as he said, "W-we followed the revelation given by Mother Tree of Desire, and using the Proliferation Necklace and a hair obtained from a particular tramp, we held a ritual to magnify the tramp's gluttony." You really did kill the tramp meant to serve as Admiral Amyrius's stand-in! Was it to prevent the admiral from leaving, thereby making him fall into the trap, have sex with Cynthia, and become corrupted? Klein instantly connected all the pieces. And my appearance introduced another possibility that happened to ruin the plan... Coincidence... That's not right! When the word "coincidence" flashed through his mind, Klein suddenly recalled what was peculiar about 4th February, the day the Mother Tree of Desire sent Flight Ken a revelation in a dream. It was the first day of his arrival on Oravi Island!
Chapter 631: Three Days of Absence Don't tell me this whole affair was aimed at me? The thought jolted Klein fully awake. After several similar experiences, he had developed something of a persecution complex. It really is possible... Just as I arrived on Oravi Island, the Mother Tree of Desire sent Flight Ken a revelation through a dream and set an entire series of plans in motion. The day I met Bilt Brando was also the day the Naturism Sect held the ritual that caused the tramp serving as a stand-in to die of gluttony... If they were targeting Admiral Amyrius, the plan needed to ensure that a stand-in was available and that he couldn't find another helper or some other means of concealing his departure. But clearly, this couldn't be guaranteed. My involvement is proof... If I was the target, that explains the previous problem. Klein used his Clown powers to control his expression as he regarded Flight Ken somberly. With such a theory, more questions emerged in his mind. But how were they certain that Bilt Brando would seek me out? The news that Gehrman Sparrow could change into anyone came from Vice Admiral Ailment Tracy. That was a factor beyond the Mother Tree of Desire's control... Of course, from another perspective, it was precisely the spread of this news, combined with my arrival on Oravi Island, that prompted the Mother Tree of Desire to send the revelation and put the plan into motion. But why would "She" want to corrupt me? My grudge against the Rose School of Thought isn't serious enough to attract the attention of an evil god. All I did was work with Miss Sharron and Maric to kill a Sequence 5 Wraith, a Sequence 6 Zombie, and a Sequence 7 Werewolf, taking the Scarlet Lunar Corona and Biological Poison Bottle... My hunt for the Admiral of Blood ended before it even began. It was merely an idea that was never put into action. The only thing that actually happened was the killing of Steel Maveti... The act of revenge that resulted from this matter shouldn't even exceed the attention of a saint! Was there something special about me that resonated with an item formed from the Mother Tree of Desire's aura the moment I set foot on this island? But I've never experienced any abnormal reactions from the holy artifacts left behind by other deities in Backlund or Tingen City. Furthermore, I divined the matter above the gray fog and received a revelation that the tramp's death was purely a coincidence. It wasn't arranged by a mythical creature or a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact, yet the outcome proved otherwise... Th-this is the first time that divination above the gray fog has been disrupted in the true sense of the word? I didn't even notice that it had been disrupted? Klein's thoughts paused as he discovered the most serious problem. Back when the matter involved 0-08, all he received was an ineffective revelation and not a disrupted outcome! Therefore, was it a power exceeding that of a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact? The Mother Tree of Desire personally interfered, and "She" is a true deity "Herself"! But it's very difficult for the seven gods to influence the real world. There has to be a corresponding ritual... Yes, I also divined the risks of acting as Amyrius above the gray fog and received a revelation that the risk was acceptable. The outcome does match how the situation developed, so that divination wasn't disrupted? The more Klein thought about it, the more perplexed he became. What he found most incomprehensible was that, if he was the target of the corruption, why hadn't he faced any difficult trials? Why had he instead resolved the problem relatively easily? This made the Mother Tree of Desire's arrangement seem like a joke! With these concerns weighing on his mind, Klein nearly crushed Flight Ken. He questioned him again to verify his conjecture. To his surprise, the Naturism Sect hadn't held any rituals over the past week to request that the Mother Tree of Desire disrupt divination. Nor had they made any special arrangements intended to make the plan fail. Strange... Klein took out a gold coin and flicked it as a final confirmation. Even without divination, he was almost certain that Flight Ken wasn't lying. First, the man was already on the brink of mental collapse and lacked the presence of mind to fabricate a plausible story. Second, Flight Ken's answers were logical and fully corroborated everything Klein had deliberately withheld. The gold coin landed in his open palm, the king's portrait facing up, indicating a positive response. Combined with the divination statement, Klein finally confirmed that Flight Ken wasn't lying. Temporarily suppressing his puzzlement, he looked at Flight Ken once more and asked without a smile, "What have you done in the past that violated the kingdom's laws or society's moral principles?" Flight Ken was taken aback for a few seconds, and his mental state seemed to improve instantly. From his point of view, his plot against Admiral Amyrius was his most serious crime and the one most likely to enrage this important figure. Everything else was trivial, nothing that required a demigod to waste his time and energy on. Therefore, setting aside the important matter and moving on to an ordinary topic meant that he might receive a favorable outcome. Flight Ken couldn't help but reveal a faint smile as he hastened to recount his deeds. "I once tortured a family for an entire night for their property, murdered them, and abandoned their bodies in the woods. Then, I used forged documents to obtain a sizable amount of wealth. "I deliberately enticed many believers to indulge in their desires and watched as their emptiness and regret after the deed slowly paved the way for them to become fertilizer for the Mother Tree of Desire. "I once tricked many ladies into following their nature, claiming that the spirits would redeem them, and used that as an excuse to possess them. "I tortured believers who attempted to renounce the religion, slicing off every part that protruded from their bodies..." He recounted every one of his sins without any thought of concealing the truth. Klein could scarcely believe what he heard. He had never imagined anyone could be so evil. As Flight Ken grew increasingly excited while recounting his past deeds, he saw Admiral Amyrius stand expressionlessly, walk around the desk, and stop in front of him. The admiral then raised his left palm. A terrifying mouth appeared in the center of the left palm, revealing two rows of illusory, eerie white teeth that were cold as ice. "No... No!" A shrill, terrified scream echoed in the room for a long time until silence prevailed. After a while, Klein bent down to pick up a blob of grayish-white light that resembled a shrunken brain. This was the Beyonder characteristic of a Lunatic! Unfortunately, Flight Ken had been searched before being brought here. He didn't leave behind any cash or items. Klein snapped his fingers and ignited the rest of the clothes. Watching his left shoulder begin to recover, he sat behind the desk and remained silent amid the dancing scarlet flames. Once the traces were no longer noticeable, he pulled at a corresponding rope, making the bell outside ring. Luan released the restriction and entered, instinctively observing every corner. "Instruct the guards and base personnel to cooperate with the Oravi police in purging the Naturism Sect. It would be best if they could find some clues and capture several members of the Rose School of Thought," Klein ordered solemnly. "Yes, Your Excellency," Luan answered respectfully. He didn't ask where Flight Ken was, as though the leader of the Naturism Sect never existed. Klein didn't pay too much attention to the raid on Oravi Island. Using the excuse that he was slightly injured, he declined the remaining schedules for the next two days. This meant that, after expending the Ninth Law charm, he wouldn't need to worry about projecting the might of a High-Sequence Beyonder of the Arbiter pathway. Near noon, Luan knocked and entered before reporting, "Your Excellency, Mr. Aston has yet to depart on the liner. The new Governor-General, Ben Conrad, has invited you to a banquet he's hosting tonight." Ben Conrad... The person who replaced Aston as governor-general... According to what I know, Viscount Conrad's family is a loyal subject of the royal family. Talim likely got to know Prince Edessak while being the equestrian teacher of Viscount Conrad's youngest son... Klein nodded gently as he immersed himself in Amyrius Rieveldt's complex emotions. He remained silent for a few seconds before saying, "Inform Governor-General Conrad that it's inconvenient for me to attend the banquet because of the injuries I suffered in the Naturism Sect's assault. "Apologize to him on my behalf." "Yes, Your Excellency." Luan didn't persuade him otherwise and calmly left the room. A demigod definitely had the right to be "willful!" As long as he didn't engage in some secret ploy or commit any serious mistake, there was no way he would be blamed regardless of what he did. This was because any faction would be willing to rope in a demigod! As he watched Luan disappear through the door, Klein shook his head almost imperceptibly and sat back down behind the desk. A quiet day quickly passed. When it was almost midnight, Klein, who was sleeping in the guest room, suddenly woke up and sat up. His spiritual perception told him that someone had entered the house! Klein focused his gaze on the window and saw a middle-aged man in a tailcoat. He had black hair and blue eyes, and the corners of his mouth sagged slightly. He was none other than Admiral Amyrius! Phew! He's finally back... Klein slowly stood up and cautiously asked, "What item did you give me before?" He was afraid that the Admiral Amyrius before him was also a Faceless in disguise. Admiral Amyrius stood there and answered with a stern expression, "The Ninth Law charm." Without waiting for Gehrman Sparrow to speak again, he took two steps forward and calmly asked, "Did anything happen in the past few days?" Klein controlled his facial muscles and said, "Your secretary committed a mistake and was injured." "Oh? What else?" Admiral Amyrius nodded with grave reserve. Klein tried hard not to move his gaze away as he looked straight at him and said, "Your younger brother has been relieved of his post as governor-general. The new governor-general has already taken over. "Your Miss Cynthia mutated into a monster and was purified by me. "Several of your bodyguards and attendants were infected to varying degrees and are currently receiving treatment." Shock gradually appeared on Amyrius's face despite his efforts to control his expression. His eyes moved slightly, as though he suspected whether he had returned to the wrong place. It had only been three days!
Chapter 632: Finishing Up After a frozen moment of silence, Amyrius quickly brought his expression under control. In a deep, commanding tone, he said, "Tell me the specifics." Klein didn't hide much of the truth. He began with Aston Rieveldt's question, before mentioning the warning from the mysterious person in the dream, and how he was told not to make a choice that resisted the trend of the times. Following that, he talked about the sudden telegram, and finally he spoke of Cynthia's mutation. He went into detail about the situation, the arrogance of the secretary, how he dealt with it, and the general investigations that followed. The only information he kept to himself was that February 4th had been his first day on Oravi Island, as well as his subsequent guesses. Of course, he was also very vague about the combat. He believed that Admiral Amyrius would understand. After all, a Beyonder's specialties and unique abilities were among their greatest secrets. If others learned of them, they could set up a targeted ambush, making it possible for a Beyonder to die at the hands of an enemy of a lower Sequence. Below the level of High-Sequence Beyonders, many Beyonders could be very powerful or very weak! Amyrius listened to the account in silence, his expression seemingly unchanged in the dark room. However, the fact that he hadn't interrupted Klein implied something. After a few seconds of silence, he asked in a deep voice, "The mysterious person who infiltrated your dream emphasized the fate of an era, as well as the trend of the times?" "Yes." Klein had already changed back into Gehrman Sparrow's appearance. He didn't deliberately go into detail that the mysterious person had never mentioned Aston Rieveldt's exact plan. Amyrius fell silent again. "You maintained my appearance in your dream?" "Yes, this is my secret," Klein answered succinctly. Amyrius nodded almost imperceptibly as he paced within a small area before looking back at Gehrman Sparrow. "There was nothing wrong with your choices." Upon hearing this, Klein seemed to receive the ultimate and most effective feedback. A large portion of the potion in him was digested as a result. In a deep, reverberating voice, Amyrius turned to the side and said without any hint of emotion, "I originally had no intention of signing a contract with the stand-in. Instead, I planned to tell Cynthia that I was showing symptoms of losing control, making it impossible for me to have physical relations with her for five days. However, I later changed my mind for certain reasons." If not for the temporary contract's forceful restriction, even if I'm able to withstand the temptations during usual times, I might not have been able to resist the magnified desires last night... Of course, if Cynthia had known about the five-day restriction in advance, she wouldn't have been in such a hurry to consume the powder ground from the Proliferation Necklace. That would've prevented her from sensing the Mother Tree of Desire and ultimately mutating... But in that case, the initiative would've rested with the Naturism Sect. They could've invented an excuse to make Cynthia consume it... This matter really was aimed at me... What does the Mother Tree of Desire actually want? Also, what caused Admiral Amyrius to make such an important change...? Klein seemed to grasp the crux of the matter as he looked at Amyrius's profile. "What's the reason?" Amyrius said with a deadpan expression, "There's no need for you to know." For the first time in his life, Klein hated such a response. After some thought, he took out the cracked pendant and threw it at Amyrius. "This is the Proliferation Necklace that originated from the Mother Tree of Desire." Amyrius raised his hand to catch it before looking down. "You may leave. "Go to Bilt to receive your reward." Aren't you worried that I know of something I'm not supposed to know? That's right. Aston's ploy has been exposed and is known by his political enemies. As for Amyrius, he was clearly not involved; therefore, it doesn't matter if I understand anything... Klein imagined that there would be a long-term confidential contract, but to his surprise, he could leave just like that. Noticing that Amyrius didn't raise another matter, he pointed at him and said, "Clothes." Only then did Admiral Amyrius look up, silently taking off the formal attire consisting of a shirt and tailcoat. Klein had originally intended to ask for additional payment because the excessive danger had gone beyond the scope of the original agreement. However, after secretly confirming that he was responsible for Cynthia's fate, he guiltily abandoned the idea. He quickly took off the comfortable sleeping robe, changed into a tailcoat, and, under Amyrius's guidance, leaped out the window and secretly left the garden villa while the bodyguards' eyes were "confounded." Amyrius donned a sleeping robe and clenched the Proliferation Necklace before walking to the window. He stood there silently as he faced the crimson moon and few stars in the dark night. He stood there expressionlessly, remaining in the same posture for a long time. Pa! He slightly relaxed his clenched fist, and fragments of the miniature rhinoceros horn fell to the ground one after another. The next day at noon, Klein, who had slept soundly the entire night, left the inn and took a carriage to Sweet Lemon Bar. He went to the second floor to meet Bilt Brando. "It's over?" Bilt asked with relief and surprise. Klein nodded and said, "Admiral Amyrius has returned. "Where's the rest of the payment?" Bilt revealed an unconcealable smile. After he dismissed his guards, he personally went to a safe and took out the remaining 500 pounds and a blue cufflink. "This is the mystical item created from the murloc bladder you provided," Bilt explained. "It can produce illusory scales beneath your skin, making you as difficult to catch as a fish. It will also help you withstand a certain amount of damage. With it, you can dive to a depth of at least fifteen meters without any protective gear and move freely underwater for ten minutes. It doesn't have any serious negative effects. It will merely make you tire easily in hot or arid places." That means this cufflink shouldn't be used with the Sun Brooch... Klein extended his hand to collect the money and item. "Aren't you afraid that there will be problems?" Bilt cracked a joke. "Your business is here," Klein answered calmly. His meaning was clear. If there were any problems, he wasn't afraid that the person in charge would go missing. Bilt's smile froze as he said, "It hasn't been named. You can give it one." "Murloc Cufflink." Klein couldn't be bothered to waste his brain cells. "Nice name. It leaves quite an impression," Bilt said with a forced smile. He paused for a moment before saying, "That Artisan said he can inscribe a spirit world creature's summoning ritual onto a spiritually rich material. It will last for at most a year and a half, but you'll need to provide detailed information. "Heh heh, according to our agreement, I'll be responsible for it, so there's nothing to be worried about." "Alright. Make it a harmonica." Klein took out a pen and paper from his pocket and scribbled the ritual to summon his messenger. "Messenger? This is rather rare. It's very hard for Beyonders not from the Death pathway to find a suitable one." Bilt received the piece of paper and casually scanned it. "Eh, if the messenger is accidentally summoned during the production process, a gold coin has to be given to her... What happens if it's not given? Heh heh. Spirit world creatures always have something odd about them. I've seen some who love music, as well as ones who loiter around shit." What happens if you don't give her one? Ma'am Reinette Tinekerr might bring the heads of you and the Artisan to me. She's a creature with a castle in the spirit world. She might even be stronger than me. Well, when I'm not using the Sea God Scepter... Klein lampooned inwardly before saying in a deep voice, "The third promised item can be left for the future." "Alright." Bilt had no objections. Then, out of curiosity, he asked, "Mr. Gehrman, how did you fool Secretary Luan, Governor-General Aston, and Miss Cynthia--the people whom Admiral Amyrius specifically mentioned?" Klein did his best to prevent his facial muscles from twitching. "Follow the information and think about it carefully." Without providing an exact explanation, he stood, removed his hat, and bowed. "It's time I bid farewell." "It was a pleasure working with you," Bilt answered with a smile. After watching Gehrman Sparrow disappear through the door, he shook his head and chuckled, muttering, "This powerful and crazy adventurer is actually a natural-born actor?" After lunch, his subordinate sent him the day's papers. Bilt was puffing on a cigar and flipping through the paper when his expression suddenly froze. Last night, the new Governor-General, Ben Conrad, held a banquet... New Governor-General? Aston Rieveldt has been relieved of his position as Governor-General? Bilt picked up the other newspapers and found the same piece of information. With his connections in Oravi, he should've long heard of news regarding a replacement of the governor-general. However, the replacement was extremely sudden. Most people only learned of the situation when the new governor-general officially made his appearance. After a while, a partner who was secretly serving Admiral Amyrius entered the room. "His Excellency wants you to investigate the people around you for believers of the Naturism Sect and sink them all into the sea," the partner said, passing on Amyrius's instructions. "Alright." Bilt asked curiously, "What exactly happened? The Naturism Sect suffered a terrible blow since yesterday." "The Naturism Sect attempted to assassinate His Excellency yesterday. Miss Cynthia perished as a result, Secretary Luan was injured, and the admiral lost many of his bodyguards," the partner explained simply. "Ah?" Bilt was momentarily stunned. A-aren't these the people Admiral Amyrius mentioned to be careful of when acting in front of them? I even specially emphasized it to Gehrman Sparrow... Now, Miss Cynthia is dead, Secretary Luan is injured, and Aston Rieveldt has been relieved of his position as Governor-General... The corners of Bilt's mouth twitched as his expression went blank. East Chester County, Stoen City. Audrey silently listened to a noble lady, occasionally echoing her sentiments and lending her a sympathetic ear. Towards the end, the noble lady praised her sincerely, "Audrey, you really are an angel. I feel a lot more comfortable after chatting with you." At that moment, Audrey saw the female priest from the Church of Evernight enter. Hence, she exchanged pleasantries before walking over with a smile. This priest appeared ordinary and delivered only basic sermons, but she was actually a secret member of the Psychology Alchemists. "Audrey, the potion formula is already in my hands. However, you need to contribute enough to obtain it," the female priest whispered while no one was paying attention. Audrey's eyes darted around slightly as she said, "That wouldn't be an issue. "However, Ma'am Smine, can you tell me its name?" The female priest looked around before saying in a hushed voice, "Hypnotist."
Chapter 633: Two Types of Parasitizing After leaving the Sweet Lemon Bar, Klein returned straight to his inn. Just as he was packing his luggage, the gigantic skeleton messenger suddenly appeared. It had intended to pat Klein on the shoulder, but its nearly four-meter-tall body made that impossible, with its head passing through the ceiling. All it could do was toss the letter forward before collapsing into nothingness. Mr. Azik has finally replied. It has been almost a week... Has the messenger changed? It looks like the original one and gives the same warning... Klein caught the letter and unfolded it. "I'm very sorry that I'm only replying to you today. "Perhaps it's because the memories I've recovered have exceeded my body's limits. I had to spend several days in a deep sleep to adapt to them. "The matters you described do correspond to the traits of the Marauder pathway. Their corresponding Sequence 4 is Parasite. At higher Sequences, they possess the Beyonder powers of the bodies they parasitize. "From what I know, there are two forms of parasitism. "The first type is a preliminary state. The Parasite would 'borrow' the Host's body to hide himself, so as to extend his lifespan and recover from his injuries. He can see and hear whatever the Host sees and hears, but he is unable to interfere with the Host's thoughts or steal his thoughts. Therefore, for a Host to converse with a Parasite, he will have to be the first to speak. "The other is complete control. The Parasite nearly fuses with the Host's Spirit Body, knows and understands his thoughts, and takes control of the body. "When facing the first type of Parasite, one can inform the Host through dreams or subconscious conversation without worrying about being discovered. This is because the Parasite must use the Host's senses to perceive his surroundings. "In the second state, there is no way to converse with the Host without the Parasite's knowledge. However, there is a chance of eradicating the Parasite by relying on the Host's faith. It's very difficult for me to describe such matters accurately. All I can say is that when someone opens his heart while praying, the target of the prayer can discover the Parasite's existence and, through a particular ritual, provide feedback that completes the separation or eradication. "Of course, the prerequisite is that the Host himself doesn't know of this; otherwise, the Parasite would definitely be alerted and begin carrying out preventive measures..." Isn't the latter situation somewhat similar to Little Sun's? He prayed to me without much thought, and I discovered the existence of Amon's avatar. Then, with a concealed goal, I taught him the secret deed ritual and used it to cleanse the Parasite... Klein instantly had a deeper understanding of the previous situation he was in. However, I'm currently unable to determine which state my dear poet is in. Back in Tingen, he would occasionally talk to himself. This might indicate the first form of parasitism, but the problem is that several months have passed. It's possible that the Parasite has taken complete control of Leonard. I have to first confirm the matter before knowing what I should do. Otherwise, rashly entering his dream will only lead to preemptively warning the Parasite, making the problem more serious and harder to resolve... If it's the second state, my dear poet believes in the Goddess, but "She" has millions of believers. It's unlikely that "She" would pay special attention to a Red Glove who's neither a Blessed nor a saint... She's unlike me, The Fool. I read every prayer and often provide a one-to-one service. This is what it's like during the "startup phase"... As Klein thought over it, he suddenly sighed and felt wistful. He had originally planned to entrust Emlyn with secretly monitoring Leonard Mitchell to see whether he often whispered to himself. However, because Emlyn had already revealed himself to Leonard and the Parasite during the matter involving Tinder, there was a high chance that they were wary of or investigating him. Therefore, Klein rationally abandoned the idea. Miss Magician is only a Sequence 8 Trickmaster. She isn't capable of monitoring an angel-level Parasite or a Red Glove... Miss Justice's identity is the best form of concealment. Besides, she's also a believer of the Goddess. But the problem lies in the fact that she's back in her fief. She will only return to Backlund in June... Mr. Hanged Man and Ma'am Hermit are at sea. As for Little Sun, there's no way for him to connect with the outside world... There still aren't enough Tarot Club members, and the networks they've developed remain inadequate. I can't find anyone suitable to help me complete this task. Among the people I know, Miss Sharron would be the best choice for such a task when it comes to concealment, but I have no way to contact her, even through Miss Magician or Emlyn... Sigh, I fled Backlund in such a hurry that I failed to consider many of the consequences... Klein raised his hand to knead his temples as he thought about how Leonard was an elite Red Glove in the Nighthawks. There were high-ranking deacons and the Church watching over him, so it was unlikely the Parasite would dare to do anything for now. Hence, he decided to put the matter aside and wait for a more suitable helper. Perhaps I can wait until I digest the potion and head to the eastern reaches of the Sonia Sea to find mermaids. After completing my advancement, I can return to Backlund and do it myself... The experienced Klein hesitated no further and quickly made up his mind. Inside Sweet Lemon Bar. After the uneasy Bilt handled two Naturism Sect believers among his close aides, he finally received some good news. "Are you telling me that Admiral Amyrius will be returning to Bayam today?" He stood up with a cigar in hand. Sothoth nodded gently and said, "His fleet left the harbor half an hour ago. It's sailing toward the Rorsted Archipelago." Phew... Bilt didn't conceal his sigh of relief, having confirmed that the admiral wasn't putting any blame on him. Just thinking about how Gehrman Sparrow had managed to "make" the admiral lose so many bodyguards, his younger brother's position as Governor-General, his secretary to injury, and his mistress to death made Bilt question his own managerial abilities. Although these matters weren't necessarily Gehrman Sparrow's fault, having them all happen at once made the crazy adventurer seem responsible. At the very least, his luck was appalling. As his employer and guarantor, Bilt believed he couldn't escape responsibility and would inevitably face Admiral Amyrius's punishment. "His Excellency is indeed a demigod. He didn't let rage cloud his judgment. Praise the Lord. May the Storm be with us," Bilt said as he struck his right fist against his left breast. At that moment, the subordinates he sent rushed back. "Boss! Gehrman Sparrow has disappeared!" the subordinate reported in a hurried tone. Bilt frowned slightly. "Disappeared?" "Yes! After checking out of his room, he carried his suitcase around the area several times before disappearing!" the subordinate reported truthfully. It's really difficult to monitor an adventurer who can shapeshift into anyone... Bilt sighed and said, "Leave it. "There's no need to seek him out again." After being targeted by the Mother Tree of Desire, Klein cautiously changed his appearance, identity, and residence to prevent anyone from finding him. Based on the feedback he had received from acting as Admiral Amyrius, he decided to digest the potion quickly by putting what he had learned into practice. Klein rode a carriage to the Oravi Hospice Foundation and once again walked inside. The person in charge of the registration was still Ma'am Joanna. She looked up and asked, "You want to do volunteer work?" "Yes." Klein nodded seriously. Joanna took out a form and asked mechanically, "Name." Klein smiled and replied, "Sinbad Volentier." The weather in East Chester County during April was comfortable. The vegetation was lush and the scenery was beautiful. It was the perfect season for hunting. Audrey wore a fitted black riding suit and a helmet. Mounted on her burgundy mare, she pursued a brightly colored wild chicken. She shot a whistling arrow and accurately struck the prey. As a Psychiatrist, her physical attributes had clearly been enhanced. Combined with the archery training she had received from a young age, this made her quite skilled with both firearms and bows. A golden figure pounced forward and rapidly bit onto the prey which had lost its life. It was none other than Susie. "It's a pleasure working with you." Audrey smiled and tapped her palm against Susie's paw. At that moment, the aristocrats surrounding her came over, either praising her for her hunting prowess or her training of her hunting hound. Audrey felt a little ashamed regarding the latter half. She had never trained Susie before! The aristocrats quickly dispersed and resumed chasing their prey. The low-ranking priest of the Evernight Goddess approached and said to Audrey in a hushed voice, "You can receive the Hypnotist formula after completing the final mission." Finally... Audrey's eyes lit up as she silently nodded. To be frank, if she were still the green and squeamish noble lady of the past, she would've long lost the patience to accumulate the required contributions and would've ended up requesting the purchase of the Hypnotist potion formula at the Tarot Club. But she knew very well that accumulating contributions would aid her infiltration of the Psychology Alchemists. She would gain more trust and lay a solid foundation for obtaining High-Sequence potion formulas in the future. Therefore, she patiently completed every task, whether interesting or not. Of course, Audrey hadn't wasted the past two months. She had eavesdropped on conversations among the aristocrats and maidservants, guided them into pouring out their frustrations, and helped them overcome their negative emotions. This allowed her to act as a Psychiatrist to near perfection. During this process, she realized that she would unconsciously eavesdrop on, observe, and steer the people around her to understand their flaws and habitual thought processes. She believed she could place any one of them at a disadvantage or mentally break them without leaving a trace. She could also make them help her of their own volition without even realizing it. I have to admit, it's rather terrifying, like the monsters in legends that can seize control of your mind... Recalling the experience, Audrey couldn't help sighing inwardly. Smine was somewhat unaccustomed to riding as she carefully circled the area and said, "Stoen University's Associate Professor Michele is a collector. We want you to purchase a notebook from the Twenty Year War." The Twenty Year War was fought between the Loen Kingdom and the Feysac Empire from 621 to 642 of the Fifth Epoch. The former was defeated and lost the ancient elven island that is now Sonia Island.
Chapter 634: City of White Stoen University... Professor Michele... A notebook from the Twenty Year War... Audrey picked out the key points and glanced at Susie, who was running happily ahead of the mare. She came straight to the point. "Ma'am Smine, what kind of notebook is it?" "I'm not sure. I only know that it dates from the Twenty Year War and belongs to Associate Professor Michele's collection. It has one distinctive feature--the pattern on its cover faintly resembles a dragon." Smine concealed nothing from Audrey, telling her everything she knew. Audrey, who silently listened to her descriptions, restrained her burgundy mare as she considered how she could complete the mission. Visiting Associate Professor Michele, viewing his collection, and then asking to buy one of its items shouldn't be too difficult. Although it's embarrassing to admit, he's unlikely to reject me regardless of how I phrase the request. Yes, Audrey, you shouldn't rely too heavily on these advantages... The greatest problem is how abrupt it would seem. I didn't know Associate Professor Michele before this, so a sudden visit would be difficult to explain. Besides, I don't know what the notebook means to him. Declaring my desire to purchase it might put him on his guard. ...Jen's elder brother studies at Stoen University. At our last gathering, he showed how fond he was of describing and discussing things. If I invite him and his sister to my next afternoon tea and steer the conversation toward history, archaeology, or collecting, he'll probably mention Associate Professor Michele. Yes, there can't be many people at a university known for their collections. With that pretext, I can send someone to visit Associate Professor Michele and request a viewing of his collection. At our first meeting, I'll do my best not to reveal my interest in it. I'll observe the owner's behavior and guide him into revealing his true self. That will help me choose the right approach, request, and moment. After confirming her line of thought, Audrey nodded at Smine and smiled. "I'll work hard to complete the mission, but I can't guarantee success." As she said that, she tightened the girth, then shot forward like an arrow toward a reddish-brown fox darting within the hunting enclosure. On the tumultuous sea, the Blue Avenger was like a leaf tumbling amid heavy squalls. From time to time, it would be hurled upward before crashing back into the waves, but it maintained a stunning balance without any sign of capsizing. Inside the captain's cabin, Alger Wilson hovered by the window, watching the mountain-high waves outside. Fierce winds silently swirled around him. Some time later, he planted his feet on the carpet. Wind-blessed is indeed a Sequence whose name lends itself to "acting." The only problem is that it occasionally makes me irascible, perfectly matching the temperament of a gale... Alger sighed inwardly, feeling no delight. Over the past two months or so, he had failed to obtain the Ocean Songster formula through his own channels or trades in the Tarot Club. After all, it was a Sequence 5 formula, the Sequence closest to a demigod. Demand for such a formula far outstripped supply. Even with boatloads of money and a willingness to pay a premium, it was very difficult to buy one. Normally, joining the corresponding Church or organization was the most effective way to obtain a formula, but as a bishop of the Church of Storms, Alger couldn't rely on this method. Due to certain secrets, he needed to conceal his strength to gain the freedom to act while remaining under only light surveillance. Only after he had sufficient confidence would he head to a particular place and complete the goal he had pursued all this time. To his relief, he hadn't wasted the past two months. At the very least, he had digested the Wind-blessed potion at a fairly good pace. The Wind-blessed is simple. Ocean Songster is said to be quite difficult... Must I sing frequently? Alger couldn't help turning his head toward the deck. Although he was separated from them by several rooms, he could still hear the drunken sailors singing with gusto, creating a din that could rival the storm's roars. Alger unknowingly frowned. Backlund, Cherwood Borough. Synthes Circus. "Ma'am, didn't you say you perform magic? Why are you dressed like that?" a puzzled youth asked. The woman wore a pitch-black pointed hat and a dress of the same color. I don't know why I'm wearing this either. I must've lost my mind from the cold when I first appeared here, and the costume became permanent afterward... Fors rubbed her face, which was painted red and yellow, and replied with a smile, "In ancient times, magic was often mistaken for witchcraft." But this has nothing to do with why I'm wearing this... She picked up the middle of the three porcelain cups in front of her, then placed a white ball beneath it. Then, she quickly switched the positions of the cups before smiling at the youth who had questioned her. "Guess where the tiny ball is?" "Isn't this one of the gambling games invented by Emperor Roselle?" the youth asked with keen interest. "But you're not a croupier; you're a circus trickmaster. Therefore, I believe you've already removed the ball. All three cups are empty!" Fors smiled and said, "Congratulations, you got it wrong." She suddenly picked up the cup in the middle as a white blur flew out. It was a dove! As for the tiny ball from before, it was now where the dove had been! "Wow!" "Godly!" "Wonderful magic!" "Brilliant!" After the series of amazed exclamations, Fors looked distinctly pleased with herself. She glanced at the distant cathedral clock, put away her props, and returned to the circus master's tent. "Are you really resigning? I can double your salary!" the circus master came over as he tried to persuade her otherwise. Unfortunately, I summarized the Trickmaster principles by mid-March and completely digested the potion last week. If my contract hadn't ended today, I wouldn't even be here... Although being a Trickmaster feels very nice, that won't stop me from pursuing my goal of advancing to Astrologer. Teacher said he would give me the formula, ingredients, and a gift this week... What kind of gift will it be? Sigh, the ravings during the full moon are becoming more terrifying. If not for Mr. Fool, I definitely would've lost control and become a monster... Fors raised her right hand to cover her mouth and yawned languidly. Then, she said with a smile, "Well, I'm actually a best-selling author. My next book is about circuses, so I came here to work." "A best-selling author?" The circus master's eyes lit up with mingled hope and worry. "Will you write anything bad about us?" "Is there anything bad to write? I've had a great time over the past two months." Fors took off her pointed black hat. The circus master revealed a sincere smile and said, "Well, Ma'am Wall, could you mention our circus by name in your book? I-I'll pay you an advertising fee. Of course, it won't be much. As you know, I'm responsible for many people's livelihood." That can be done? This circus master is quite smart... For the first time, Fors realized that a novel could "advertise" just like in newspapers or magazines. Furthermore, the format was more obscure and natural. Amid the waves, a liner with rows of cannons traveled along a safe sea route without daring to stray far from it. Any deviation from the sea route east of Oravi Island usually meant disappearing. Even pirates didn't dare to stray too far from the safe zones. This sea was full of unexplored regions and all manner of sensational legends! After two months of volunteer work and four opportunities to engage in true acting, Klein bade farewell to carrying patients, scrubbing toilets, cleaning up vomit, and other miscellaneous chores. He boarded a ship headed for the Gargas Archipelago. At the Tarot Gathering in early March, he had hired The Hermit Cattleya in a private conversation. He would meet her in Nas, the City of White and capital of the Gargas Archipelago. He would then board her ship and head for the dangerous, almost illusory waters at the far eastern edge of the Sonia Sea. There, he would search for unaffiliated mermaids. The Hermit Cattleya seemed very interested in meeting members of the Tarot Club in the real world. After only a few seconds of thought, she agreed to The World's request. However, because of the great danger involved, she had named a high price. 3,000 pounds! Klein's first reaction was to give up and take Mr. Hanged Man's ghost ship, but that would mean traveling with many sailors from the Church of Storms, limiting his freedom. Considering this and the extreme danger in the easternmost area of the Sonia Sea, he ultimately accepted Ma'am Hermit's terms. She would wait near the Gargas Archipelago for a month beginning in early April. Any delay would mean the end of their cooperation. To avoid wasting the thousand-pound deposit, Klein didn't wait to complete his digestion before heading from Oravi Island to the Gargas Archipelago. Of course, with the summaries and chances at true acting from before, he was already very close to completely digesting the Faceless potion. Even if he didn't use true acting, just acting in his capacity as Gehrman Sparrow was enough to complete the digestion in two to three weeks. For this reason, and because The World's identity was tied to Gehrman Sparrow, Klein transformed back into the powerful, lunatic adventurer once he left the hospice. However, he did disguise himself to a certain degree. As he watched the perturbed sea surface, Klein finally saw a port city that had houses mainly made of white rock. The Feysac Empire's easternmost outpost and the capital of the Gargas Archipelago--Nas! I'm finally overseas... Klein watched a rugged fishing boat carrying whale meat cruise into the harbor. Meanwhile, he discovered several ships hanging pirate flags docked at the harbor without any signs of concealment. Indeed, the waters east of Oravi Island are a playground for pirates... Klein put on his hat, picked up his luggage, and left the cabin after the liner came to a halt. He descended the gangway into the harbor. After a few steps, he saw a pirate crew apparently come into conflict with a local gang. Both sides drew their weapons and clashed. Klein calmly walked past, showing no signs of stopping them. At that moment, he saw a local pull several cans from his pocket, open their lids, and throw them into the middle of the road. What's the point of that? Klein nearly laughed aloud before recalling an infamous item found at sea. Canned wolf-fish! Canned wolf-fish was popular on the east coast of Feysac and the Gargas Archipelago! The moment the thought surfaced, an indescribable stench assailed Klein's nose. His facial muscles twitched as he fought his body's discomfort and quickly left the area. A few pirates struck by the stench vomited immediately, while the rest frantically fled, dragging their companions as though they had lost all ability to fight. A minute later, in a secluded corner, the crazy adventurer, Gehrman Sparrow, crouched down and silently belched.
Chapter 635: Meeting The smell of canned wolf-fish is truly overpowering... Not only does it stink, but it's also nauseating... It's practically a biological weapon! Crouched in the corner, Klein took nearly a minute to recover. Until that moment, he had underestimated canned wolf-fish and failed to take the necessary precautions. He could've used a Paper Figurine Substitute or created an invisible air tube to imitate Underwater Breathing, but he had done neither. Now he finally understood the wisdom of banning canned wolf-fish from being opened in public! Phew... Klein exhaled as he slowly stood up. Carrying his suitcase, he walked toward the harbor. His first impression of Nas was of its many white houses, with stone being the most common building material. His second was that, although the city wasn't too far north, it was rather cold. Even though it was already April, the temperature was still only a few degrees Celsius. His third was of the many whaling facilities. Gigantic beluga whales were being butchered for their skin, flesh, fat, bones, and ambergris. The latter two could be used, respectively, to make panniers for formal dresses and top-grade fragrances. Whether used in incense or perfume, these were luxury goods that only the wealthy and nobles could enjoy. The beluga whales' skin, flesh, and fat also had their own uses. They were used to make clothing, food, and oil-based products. In Nas and the Gargas Archipelago, methods of preparing beluga whale had developed into a unique culinary culture, with all sorts of techniques and famous restaurants. Klein passed the various whaling facilities and saw rendered fat being carried in freight wagons toward nearby factories that spewed black smoke. These were oil refineries characteristic of Gargas. Whale fat could be refined into oil, bottled for use as an excellent incendiary, and used as the lifeblood of certain industries. Very unique... Klein exhaled some mist as he stopped and watched for a while. Upon leaving the harbor and entering the city, a cacophony of spoken Feysac inundated his ears. Having mastered Ancient Feysac--the source of the Northern Continent's languages--Klein had long been familiar with the tongue of the Northern Continent's barbarians. He turned toward the din and saw tall, slightly blond locals marching through the streets with banners held aloft. The banner at the very front clearly stated the reason for their protest. "Oppose the poaching of beluga whales! We need sustainable development!" Pfft... Klein nearly lost his cool as he believed that the concept of "sustainable development" was highly likely to be "invented" by Emperor Roselle. As he swept his gaze, he looked at the banners behind it and understood the goals of the protest. "Whaling for survival, not entertainment!" "Humans aren't more important than beluga whales!" "Greedy devils should leave Nas!" At that moment, policemen dressed in gray uniforms held shields, riot forks, and batons to stop the protesters from advancing. After a brief argument, the scene quickly turned violent. Many young protesters threw open cans of wolf-fish and Molotov cocktails. The police showed no restraint as they charged forward, raising their shields and striking with their batons. Klein pinched his nose as he watched fires burn in the street. He realized that many passersby were completely unfazed. Apart from a small group of spectators, the rest continued about their business. It appears such things happen often in Nas... Do protests regularly develop into riots? As expected of the Feysac Empire... Klein muttered to himself, detoured around the street, and casually found an inn. He continued to register as Gehrman Sparrow, unconcerned that the news released by Vice Admiral Ailment Tracy would lead the Church of the Evernight Goddess to identify him as a Faceless. He had no intention of traveling along the whaling routes to find mermaids who believed in the Goddess. Instead, he planned to head to the dangerous region at the easternmost edge of the Sonia Sea. As for the safety in the Gargas Archipelago, there was nothing he needed to worry about. This was a colony of the Feysac Empire. The only legal Church was the Church of the God of Combat. They were enemies with the Church of the Evernight Goddess. Klein had originally worried that he would encounter many Faceless here, perhaps meeting seven or eight simply by stepping next door to enjoy some whale cuisine. However, after careful consideration, he rationally dismissed this possibility. First, Beyonders of the Seer pathway were rare to begin with. Klein had met only three who were above Sequence 8. Second, Sequence 6 Beyonders weren't commonly seen. Even in a playground for pirates, people with bounties of 5,000 pounds were considered rare. Third, once a Faceless had made sufficient preparations, they would board a whaling ship in search of mermaids. They would then either begin believing in the Goddess, sink to the bottom of the ocean, or become research subjects. The exceptionally clever ones would seize the opportunity to advance successfully and leave safely. It was very rare for them to remain in the Gargas Archipelago for long. In all of Nas, excluding myself, there can't be more than two Faceless... Klein straightened his clothes. In no hurry to contact Admiral of Stars Cattleya, he took to the streets in a good mood and began searching for delicacies he had heard about during his travels. Raw slices of beluga whale, fried whale steak, whale skin with oil, roasted whale meat... Like an ordinary traveler, Klein visited three restaurants and sampled a variety of dishes. Not bad. It's quite distinctive and not very fishy. Instead, it's appetizing and delicious... Burp... Klein covered his mouth as he emerged onto the street. He noticed that the street lamps were sparse, but the houses lining the road were brightly lit, reducing the darkness to some extent. Icy winds blew in from the ocean, prompting Klein to raise his collar. The blue cufflinks were fastened securely at his wrists, their luster subdued. Compared to rings, cufflinks were better suited to Gehrman Sparrow's persona. Therefore, Klein didn't blame the Artisan for making changes without his permission. As for the harmonica into which the summoning ritual for a spirit world creature had been inscribed, it perfectly matched Klein's private wishes. It could be used for a year and a half and was exquisitely crafted from silver. When he received the harmonica, Klein had imagined this scene--a crazy and powerful adventurer playing a mournful tune beside a boat on a silent night beneath the dim moonlight. Unfortunately, the harmonica couldn't produce any sound, and it could only be used to summon Reinette Tinekerr. Shaking his head almost imperceptibly, Klein walked steadily through Nas's empty, cold streets before returning to his inn. After a night's sleep restored him to his optimal state, he went to Gray Amber Street the next morning and entered a general store named Hot Whale Dance. Upon seeing the grizzled boss who was a head taller than him, Klein tapped the counter and said in Feysac, "Whale oil." The boss's face was deeply lined, but he wore only a coat made of beluga whale skin. Its pale patterns possessed a strange beauty. "How much?" The boss gulped liquor, ignoring the disarray of the goods around him. "One and a quarter buckets," Klein replied according to the predetermined secret password. The boss's movements immediately slowed as he placed his cup of brownish-green liquor on the counter. "Do you want to try some? It's many times purer than Nepos. It's considered the mistress of all Feysac men." This distilled liquor was a Feysac specialty brewed from potatoes or grain. Its alcohol content was high, and it rivaled Blaze in both potency and fame. Compared with Sonia blood wine, it was inexpensive and popular among ordinary Feysacians. "There's no need." Klein shook his head. The boss chuckled. "What kind of man are you if you don't drink Nepos? "Are there only women in Loen?" He mumbled before drinking another mouthful. "Who introduced you here?" "Ma'am Gehrmuses," Klein said, giving a name that followed local conventions. The boss exhaled, causing a strong scent of distilled liquor to linger in the air. He staggered as he got up, like a polar bear performing at a circus. After giving the store employee instructions, he brought Klein to a tiny room on the second story of the warehouse at the back. "Let me search for it. Let's see..." the boss mumbled as he crouched. Klein controlled the twitching of his facial muscles as he recalled a widely circulated joke in the Loen Kingdom. "When is a Feysac man not drunk? When he's in his mother's womb." After waiting for a moment, Klein saw the boss find a pure crystal ball from his rummaging. Then, the tipsy "polar bear" turned his back to Klein, rubbed his hands over the crystal ball, and softly chanted in tongue-twisting ancient Hermes. The room gradually darkened, and every unlit corner seemed to sink inward as though exerting a strange pull. The crystal ball quickly lit up, producing the figure of a woman wearing a black, classic robe. She had an oval face and very fair skin. Her deep-black eyes held a faint purple hue and an air of mystery. I'm seeing another Tarot Club member's actual appearance again... Klein stepped forward and received the crystal ball. On the opposite end of the crystal ball, The Hermit Cattleya could also clearly see The World. He had black hair and brown eyes, with a thin and angular face. Her gaze paused for a moment before she hesitantly said, "Gehrman Sparrow?" She discovered that the Tarot Club members' true strength and caliber far exceeded her expectations. The World was none other than the mad hunter Gehrman Sparrow, whose strength was considered comparable to that of a pirate admiral! My various assumptions of The World were problematic... Controlled, steady, experienced, and ruthless... Admiral of Stars Cattleya wasn't overly surprised. "Yes, Ma'am Cattleya." Klein gestured for the boss to leave the room. After it became extremely quiet, Admiral of Stars Cattleya asked once again, "I'm very curious. How did you recognize my identity? I've been very careful when participating in the gatherings." Of course, she had jumped in fright when The World, who had chosen to speak privately with her, immediately greeted her with "Admiral of Stars." And it was partly because of this that she chose to take on The World's commission. "A secret." Klein smiled politely. Since he didn't want her to connect this to Mr. Fool, he calmly added, "Your eyes are very special." "Can I understand that as a form of praise?" Cattleya smiled, feeling somewhat enlightened. She believed that The World had previously suspected she was Admiral of Stars based only on her eyes and other details, but hadn't been certain. Hence, he had tested her verbally, and her reaction had revealed the answer. Klein didn't respond as he switched to asking, "When can we set off?"
Chapter 636: Slaughterer Admiral of Stars Cattleya considered the question before answering, "Tonight at eight. Dock 6." Not bad. There's no delay at all... Klein nodded slightly. "Okay." Klein hailed a rental carriage and told the driver in Feysac to head to the Lerdal Bar. The smallest denomination was the kopek, followed by the feysilver, and then the gold hoorn. They maintained the very intuitive base-ten denomination, making conversions very simple. I forgot to visit a bank to exchange money for kopeks and feysilver... I've used Loen currency at the inn and restaurants all this time... Gold pounds, soli, and pence can be used here too? Yes, the Gargas Archipelago isn't far from Toscarter and Oravi. Loen's industrial and economic strength exceeds that of the Feysac Empire. It can even be said to be far greater. The gold pound is worth much more than the gold hoorn... Wait! Suddenly, he recalled something. One gold pound could be used to exchange for 5.5 gold hoorn. This also meant that two soli were equal to 5.5 feysilver. Klein turned back and realized that the carriage had long disappeared. Sigh... Gently exhaling, Klein pressed down on his hat and pushed open the heavy wooden door before entering the Lerdal Bar.
